intent: Four cloud decks remain beautiful at every altitude. Nearby real-world cloud parallax and distant slow cloud motion communicate acceleration, atmospheric depth and planetary scale with minimal GPU/CPU work.

layers.why: Close optical motion as momentum increases; low hover aesthetics and possible fly-through.
Slower optical motion from greater physical distance; depth during active ascent.
Majestic cinematic cloud formations remain visible from near-sea-level and drift gently.
Sparse cloud cards above single opaque planet surface during the globe reveal; no extra globe mesh.

altitudeMoods.purpose: calm ocean, dramatic high clouds, clear deep-blue water/sky horizon
strong nearby cloud movement vs slow overhead clouds
clouds above and below, emphasize large-scale depth
globe-forward cloud formations, high layers visually quiet

transition: smoothstep weights only; no hard abrupt visibility toggle at altitude band boundaries
invariants: Do not resize world or alter collision to implement cloud parallax
Keep src/horizon.js ocean and terrain projection shared; never add a blue globe overlay
Keep low clouds world-anchored so apparent motion follows actual ship movement
Four layers must not all follow the camera at identical rates
High clouds remain visible from sea-level
Planetary deck is hidden unless globeReveal is positive
Do not change src/flight-momentum.js or the island flyby reward
Do not remove optional Tiled exporter; previous antivirus investigation is separate
Keep low-memory performance budget and verify on the 4 GB device before merging
